title: Subthreshold laser treatment for reticular pseudodrusen secondary to age-related macular degeneration

groups.agent: end-point management yellow (577 nm) subthreshold laser, Pascal Synthesis, one extrafoveal 1.27 mm2 area
groups.description: PASCAL pilot trial (NCT02800356): 20 eyes of 20 patients with reticular pseudodrusen secondary to dry (non-neovascular) AMD, one subthreshold laser session at baseline, followed for 3 months.

exclusions.what: Table 2 p-value columns (Tab2!R3C3, C5, C7, C8)
Table 2 CMT, choroidal thickness, ONL thickness, microperimetry and fixation rows

exclusions.reason: Medians and ranges are not admissible; the text means agree with the cited Table 2 cells

notes: Indication 'other': reticular pseudodrusen secondary to dry AMD without macular neovascularization or edema, treated with laser (a macular condition within scope).
BCVA was measured with Snellen charts and converted to LogMAR for every patient for the analysis (Statistical analysis); Table 2 gives LogMAR only.
Study eye: the eye with the worse BCVA at baseline when both eyes were eligible (baseline choice).
Prior AMD treatment of the study eye (other than antioxidants) was an exclusion criterion (prior_treatment naive).
Role treated: subthreshold laser for reticular pseudodrusen is the experimental intervention of this non-randomized pilot trial.
Fellow eyes received no treatment for AMD during the study and are not reported for acuity.

series.notes: mean ± SD (Table 2 subheader); per-visit n not reported, no withdrawal reported
